# NM Technology Integrated Solutions

> NM Technology is Albuquerque, New Mexico's top-rated local low voltage systems integrator specializing in CCTV surveillance, fire alarm systems, access control, security alarms, and structured cabling for commercial and residential clients.

## Company Info

- Website: https://nmtechnology.us
- Location: Albuquerque, New Mexico
- Type: Licensed Low Voltage Contractor & Security Systems Integrator
- Service Area: Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, Placitas, Los Lunas, Bernalillo County, Santa Fe, and all of New Mexico

## Services

- [CCTV & Surveillance Camera Installation](https://nmtechnology.us/cctv): Commercial and residential IP camera systems, NVR setup, remote monitoring, camera maintenance
- [Fire Alarm Systems](https://nmtechnology.us/fire-alarms): NFPA 72 compliant installation, fire detection, inspections, monitoring, NM State Fire Marshal compliance
- [Access Control Systems](https://nmtechnology.us/access-control): Card readers, keypad entry, biometric access, visitor management, centralized access management
- [Security & Burglar Alarm Systems](https://nmtechnology.us/security-alarms): Intrusion detection, 24/7 alarm monitoring, motion sensors, glass break detectors
- [Network Infrastructure & Structured Cabling](https://nmtechnology.us/networking): Cat5e/Cat6/Cat6a cabling, fiber optic, WiFi, network rack installation, smart hands services
- [Low Voltage System Design & Integration](https://nmtechnology.us): Complete system design, multi-system integration, project management

## Why Choose NM Technology

- Licensed, insured, and bonded low voltage contractor in New Mexico
- NFPA certified technicians
- Serves commercial, residential, industrial, healthcare, education, government, and retail
- New construction, retrofit, upgrades, maintenance, and emergency service
- 24/7 emergency service available
- Local Albuquerque company with deep knowledge of NM building codes and regulations
- Free quotes available through website
